items.text: a Pro key's error message runs across the whole Settings row instead of squeezing into the label's column
in Color › Palettes, each palette has an editor button beside its pencil: it puts the palette on and opens it in the Editor

the palette says whether your changes are kept: a palette of yours saves as you go (an undo and a ✓ saved after its pencil); a studio palette you changed shows undo and save (keep it as yours); undo puts the palette back to how it was when you put it on

power save (Settings › Power, on by default): when you switch away, the sound stops instead of keeping the device awake, and comes back with you ("back from power save"); on screen, untouched for two minutes, Current draws at half speed until a touch; never while Performing; Full turns it off
rings show where you are: inside a ring reached through a dot, a short column of dots at the foot of the middle, one per ring on the way, yours lit; tap one (or drag along them) to go straight there
in the Material ring, each color part's first dot wears its color: drag it through the scene's colors, or hold it for the color picker
the Material ring's adjust ring is named for the material (Water), not "Adjust · Water"
the Field panel's presets are whole pills again on an iPad (they were cut top and bottom); they wrap instead of scrolling

the Material ring (in the rings' switch): pick the water's surface (still, drip, rain, wake, glass) and, below, adjust it: its looks, its colors part by part, what makes its ripples; its middle switches the surface on and off; every material is defined once, so new ones join the ring by themselves
Settings › Pro key has a paste button: copy a key anywhere, tap paste, and it goes in (an installed app does not see a key opened as a link in the browser)
the studio's own key says Studio in Settings, with the tiers it opens
